title: Habits & Discipline

expressions.example: She keeps doing yoga every morning.
He stopped to check his progress.

sentences: She keeps practicing every single day.
He decided to build a new habit this year.
I stopped eating junk food last month.
They enjoy tracking their progress every week.
We stopped to celebrate our first milestone.
She quit skipping her morning routine.
He avoids procrastinating by setting small goals.
I decided to commit to a daily practice.

grammar.title: Verb + Gerund or Infinitive
rules: Alguns verbos são seguidos por gerúndio (verbo+ing): keep doing, avoid doing, enjoy doing, quit doing.
Alguns verbos são seguidos por infinitivo (to + verbo): decide to do, want to do, plan to do.
"stop doing" (parar de fazer, hábito) é diferente de "stop to do" (parar para fazer outra coisa): He stopped smoking vs. He stopped to smoke.
"give up" sempre é seguido de gerúndio: give up doing something.

rows: He decided to build a habit.
He stopped to check his progress.
